title: Item list
description: Lines each led by a mark — an icon, an emoji, a character — and said in a tone when they carry one: what a check went through, what a run listed. The tone colours the mark, or the whole line (`toned`).

icon.description: Its mark: an icon name (`ph:bold/check`), else written as it is — « ✓ », an emoji.

tone.description: The state the line is said in.

toned.description: What a tone colours: the mark, or the whole line.
